Bosnia’s Foreign Minister Elmedin Konaković warned U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio that Republika Srpska, the pro-Russia Serb-majority entity, was spending millions on Trump-linked lobbyists and consultants to gain political influence in Washington.

The warning followed reports that Trump aides Chris LaCivita and James Blair received hundreds of thousands of dollars for campaign advice. 

Konaković also urged the U.S. to consider reimposing sanctions on former Republika Srpska President Milorad Dodik, a close Putin ally whose sanctions were lifted last year.
